name: VDB 3-4-5 Tree Traversal
definition: A hierarchical sparse voxel grid structure using a 3-4-5 tree topology, where nodes are organized in levels of size 3^3, 4^4, and 5^5 voxels, stored in compressed texture atlases.
summary: VDB 3-4-5 Tree Traversal retrieves sparse volumetric data by mapping 3D coordinates to leaf values through a fixed-depth hierarchy of 3, 4, and 5-sized nodes stored in compressed texture atlases.
